name: ACA 412 请求绕飞 左发进水熄火

cards.audioText: B: You are over Tango Oscar Golf at 35, FL210, you want to descend to FL170, report to Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你在 Tango Oscar Golf 上空 35，飞行高度层 210，想下降到飞行高度层 170，向广州管制报告。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, over TOG at 35, FL210, request descend to FL170.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，在 TOG 上空 35，FL210，请求下降到 FL170。

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 412, can you make FL190 by Tango Uniform X-Ray?
B: You want FL170 because the turbulence is likely to get worse further along the route.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 412，你能在 Tango Uniform X-Ray 前达到飞行高度层 190 吗？
B: 你想要飞行高度层 170，因为航路前方乱流可能会加重。
cards.referenceText: That can't be sure, the turbulence is likely to get worse further along the route, FL170 is preferable, ACA412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 无法确定，航路前方乱流可能会加重，FL170 更合适，ACA412。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 412, we have to coordinate.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 412，我们必须协调。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 412, your request to Tango Uniform X-Ray FL170 has been approved, at the same time, remain on 215 radial Golf India Lima VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 412，你到 Tango Uniform X-Ray 飞行高度层 170 的请求已获批准，同时保持在 Golf India Lima VOR 215 径向线上。
cards.referenceText: Cross TUX FL170, remain on 215 radial GIL VOR, ACA412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 TUX 时 FL170，保持在 GIL VOR 215 径向线上，ACA412。

cards.audioText: B: You want to put off the descent, call Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你想推迟下降，呼叫管制。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, request to delay the descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，请求延迟下降。

cards.audioText:
C: Descend immediately due traffic.
B: You tell the controller that you will run into CBs if you descend right now.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 因活动立即下降。
B: 告诉管制员如果现在下降，你们会进入 CB。
cards.referenceText: The thunderstorm will be encountered if we decide right now, ACA412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我们现在下降，会遭遇雷暴，ACA412。

cards.audioText: C: Turn right heading 120 to detour the CBs.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 右转航向 120 绕飞 CB。

cards.audioText: B: You tell the controller that you will check out more than 30 miles if you go round the CBs from the right. You ask the permission of a left sight.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员，如果从右侧绕飞 CB，会偏出超过 30 miles。你请求从左侧绕飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, if we go around the CBs from the right, we have to track out more than 30 miles. How about the left side turning?
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，如果我们从右侧绕飞 CB，必须偏出超过 30 miles。能否从左侧转弯？

cards.audioText:
C: There is only 15 miles for you to go if you want to detour from the left due restricted area.
B: You need 20 miles.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 由于限制区，如果你想从左侧绕飞，只有 15 miles 可用。
B: 你需要 20 miles。
cards.referenceText: I need at least 20 miles on the left side, 15 miles is not enough, ACA412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左侧我至少需要 20 miles，15 miles 不够，ACA412。

cards.audioText: C: I will contact with the military, standby.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 我会联系军方，等待。

cards.audioText:
C: No reply from the military, what do you prefer?
B: You intend to go round the CBs from the left.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 军方没有回复，你更倾向哪种？
B: 你打算从左侧绕飞 CB。
cards.referenceText: We would like to circumnavigate the thunderstorm from the left, ACA412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们希望从左侧绕飞雷暴，ACA412。

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 412, cleared to detour the thunderstorm from the left.
B: You ran into severe turbulence in CBs, some persons injured.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 412，许可从左侧绕飞雷暴。
B: 你进入 CB 遭遇严重乱流，有人受伤。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, we have encountered the CBs with severe turbulence, some persons injured.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，我们遭遇 CB 和严重乱流，有人受伤。

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 412, what's your intention?
B: You want priority landing and medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 412，你的意图是什么？
B: 你想优先落地并需要医疗协助。
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing and medical assistance, ACA412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求优先落地和医疗协助，ACA412。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 412, emergency services will be notified. Ambulance will be there waiting for you.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 412，将通知应急服务。救护车会在那里等你。

cards.audioText: B: Declare Urgency due to port inboard engine flamed out resulting from water ingestion, you are suffering a steep left turn.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 因吸水导致左内侧发动机熄火宣布紧急状态，你们正经历急剧左转。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA412, port inboard engine flamed out resulting from water ingestion, we are suffering a steep left turn.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，广州管制，ACA412，左内侧发动机因吸水熄火，我们正在急剧左转。

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 412, roger PAN, report your intention if available.
B: You want emergency landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 412，收到 PAN，如可能报告你的意图。
B: 你想紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA412, request emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA412，请求紧急着陆。
